notes.title: Update for 2023-12-01
notes.content:
fixed bug where some Soliloquy levels were different when loaded a second time
added a "resend scores" option to the options > support menu
fixed a UI updating issue so the green triangle should show up correctly when you perfect a level

notes.title: New Soliloquy Chapters
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=nmX0tSNebx4;full][/previewyoutube]
Duet is 10 years old!

Thank you to all our fans who purchased and fell in love with Duet over the last 10 years.

To celebrate, we've created a new “Soliloquy” story available now!

“Soliloquy” includes:
- A completely new mechanic that will test your mind.
- 30 new incredible stages & new narrative.
- All-new music from composer Tim Shiel.
- Jojo Petrina returns to voice this new narrative.

There's also a new "Endless Soliloquy" challenge mode too.

notes.title: Update for 2023-07-25
notes.content:
Thanks to everyone who participated in the beta. The build has now been set live for everyone.

Changes
General changes

continuance mode now available.
Added new accessibility option in the "video" section: "epilogue: no wrapping".
Windows

Now using ANGLE to render using DIrectX to avoid OpenGL bugs and stuttering.
MacOS

Build is now 64-bit and signed. Should work on the latest version of macOS.
Now using ANGLE to render using Metal.
Known Issue - the game may ask for "Input Monitoring" permissions to play.
Linux/SteamOS/Steam Deck

no major changesIf the new build causes issues, you can play the old one by following these steps:[olist]
Navigate to Duet in your Steam library.
Right-click or Control-click Duet and select Properties.
Navigate to the BETAS tab.
Select previous_good from the drop down.[/olist]

notes.title: Duet beta 2023
notes.content:
I've recently added a new beta build of Duet that has some changes to fix the stuttering on Windows 10/11 and some other changes. This is not a free beta, you can only access it if you have already purchased Duet on Steam.

Accessing the Beta[olist]
Navigate to Duet in your Steam library.
Right-click or Control-click Duet and select Properties.
Navigate to the BETAS tab.
Select beta - Public Beta from the drop down.
Install Duet.[/olist]
Bugs and Feedback
Please post any bugs or feedback from the beta to the thread in the forums.

Changes
General changes

continuance mode now available (no leaderboards or achievements yet)
Added new accessability option in the "video" section: "epilogue: no wrapping".
Windows

Now using ANGLE to render using DIrectX to avoid OpenGL bugs and stuttering.
MacOS

Build is now 64-bit and signed. Should work on the latest version of macOS.
Now using ANGLE to render using Metal.
Known Issue - the game may ask for "Input Monitoring" permissions to play.
Linux/SteamOS/Steam Deck

no major changes

notes.title: Mac OS X and Linux Public Beta
notes.content:
Mac OS X and Linux versions of Duet will be launching soon, so today we're opening up the beta to the public! This is not a free beta, you can only access it if you have already purchased Duet on Steam.

How to Install
[olist]
Navigate to Duet in your Steam library.
Right-click or Control-click Duet and select Properties.
Navigate to the BETAS tab.
Select beta - Public Beta from the drop down.
Install Duet.
[/olist]

Bugs and Feedback
Please post any bugs or feedback from the beta to the Mac OS X and Linux Beta discussion forums.
